assembly.pi_datum: Pi centred XY, PCB bottomZ0, connector at+X32.5mm
assumptions: Mounted visual reconstruction, not a manufacturing bend-radius specification
Only thin flexible layers, routed copper and the .12mm black laminated circuit backing follow the fold
Connector stiffener, camera-head stiffener, discrete components and optics remain rigid
.12mm adhesive layer is an assembly assumption and conforms to modelled underside relief
Finite visual CSI housing limits insertion to2.05mm; original22 fingers are not wholly hidden
Small CSI spring/FPC contact overlap is visual preload, not a validated physical deflection model
assembly.camera_rigid_transform_scope: Legacy key applies only to the 202 underside/head rigid source parts; it is not the transform for every rigid camera part.
assembly.rigid_transform_units: mm; maps original centred ZeroCam source coordinates to Pi assembly coordinates

geometry.pi_preservation_method: Unchanged source-file SHA256; direct source Shape identity/isSame/isEqual plus exact vertex coordinates, topology counts, bounds and volume checks. Serializer cache bytes are not compared.
geometry.interference_scope: camera parts against Pi parts; intra-device pairs not assessed
